## Standards

<a id="Http"></a>

### HTTP

`Http` · `src/standards.ts:9`

What the API answers, and how the service calls the payment provider.

Source: RFC 9110, HTTP Semantics: § 9 methods, § 15 status codes, § 8.3 Content-Type, § 11.6.2 Authorization; RFC 6750, § 2.1 (Bearer) · `https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110`

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `ok` | `200` | The request succeeded |
| `notFound` | `404` | Nothing answers at this address, or nothing has this identifier |
| `serverError` | `500` | The server failed |
| `unavailable` | `503` | The service cannot answer for now |
| `post` | `POST` | Asks the server to act |
| `contentType` | `content-type` | The media type of the body |
| `authorization` | `authorization` | The credentials of the caller |
| `bearer` | `"Bearer "` | The scheme of a token and its space, before the token |
| `scheme` | `http` | The scheme of the address the server listens at |

- Maintained by: karim
- Used by: [Cancel a reservation](api.md#CancelReservation), [Read a reservation](api.md#ReadReservation), [Real payment provider](infra.md#HttpPayment), [Node HTTP server](infra.md#NodeServer), [Read a reservation](scenarios.md#ReadScenario), [Cancelling twice refunds only once](scenarios.md#RepeatedCancellationScenario)

How an HTTP entry point names its path: segments separated by slashes, a parameter as a colon followed by its name.

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|

| `begin` | `BEGIN` | Starts a transaction |
| `commit` | `COMMIT` | Makes its writes last |
| `rollback` | `ROLLBACK` | Undoes them |

<a id="Uri"></a>

### URI

`Uri` · `src/standards.ts:43`

The parts of an address: the server's, and the path of a request.

Source: RFC 3986, § 3 Syntax components; RFC 6761, § 6.3 (localhost) · `https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3986`

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `schemeEnd` | `:` | Ends the scheme |
| `authority` | `//` | Opens the host and its port |
| `portSeparator` | `:` | Separates the host from its port |
| `pathSeparator` | `/` | Separates the segments of a path |
| `query` | `?` | Opens the query, after the path |
| `localhost` | `localhost` | The machine itself |
